title: Update expense VAT specification source
summary: Expense Agent now sets the Source of VAT specification records to Agent when created through the API and Manual when created in the UI, blocks changes and deletions of agent-created records, and gives more specific errors when posting expense reports with pending VAT reclaim status.
key_points: Source is set to Agent for API-created VAT specifications and Manual for UI-created ones; the Source field is now non-editable
Agent-created VAT specification records cannot be modified or deleted, and UpdateVATSpecification no longer overwrites them
Certain validations and category/subcategory handling apply only to manual entries
Posting errors for pending VAT reclaim status are more specific and offer navigation actions
Adds an upgrade codeunit and expanded test coverage
